usage_tiers.notes: Free evaluation keys are rate-limited and intended for testing or proofs of concept, not a production route.
Production use requires an appropriate production key and remains subject to model-specific availability, terms, and rate limits.
NVIDIA Developer Program hosted NIM endpoints are a no-cost trial for one-account prototyping, development, testing, and evaluation only; endpoint availability is model-specific.
The Developer Program trial grants no production or commercial entitlement; production requires a separate eligible NVIDIA or partner subscription and its terms.

trial_terms.access_scope: Free NVIDIA-hosted NIM API endpoints are for prototyping, development, testing, and evaluation only; not every API Catalog or Speech NIM is a hosted free endpoint.
trial_terms.account_scope: One NVIDIA Developer account and Developer API key can authenticate calls to API Catalog model endpoints available to that account; availability and entitlement remain model-specific.
trial_terms.rate_limit_note: NVIDIA does not publish one universal trial limit; limits vary by model and concurrent demand and must be checked in the signed-in API Catalog account.

recommendation.reason: Convenient for user-directed experimentation because one NVIDIA Developer account/key can cover multiple available preview model services; every model and modality still requires explicit selection and readiness checks.
